Non è un antivirus: usa euristiche (tipo: This is not an antivirus: it uses heuristics (real type, entropy, suspicious strings), not up-to-date malware signatures.
Per un parere di più motori antivirus ce: For an opinion from several antivirus engines, look up the SHA-256 on VirusTotal; to see how the file behaves you need a sandbox.
Analizza solo file tuoi o che sei autori: Only analyse files that are yours or that you are authorised to examine: do not upload documents containing other people’s personal data.

I primi byte non corrispondono a nessun: The first bytes do not match any known format: the content may not be what the extension claims.
Estensione e contenuto non coincidono: Extension and content do not match

{n} URL trovati tra le stringhe: verific: {n} URLs found among the strings: check what the file would connect to.
